description.en: Digital transaction infrastructure platform for the real estate market. Unites property owners, buyers, agents, agencies, developers, banks, and notaries into a single ecosystem with map-first discovery, deal pipeline management, digital power of attorney, escrow, mortgage facilitation, and document verification.
description.uz: Ko'chmas mulk bozori uchun raqamli tranzaksiya infratuzilma platformasi. Xaridorlar, agentlar, agentliklar, quruvchilar, banklar va notariuslarni xarita asosidagi kashfiyot, bitim pipeline boshqaruvi, raqamli ishonchnoma, eskrou, ipoteka yordami va hujjat tekshiruvi bilan birlashtiradi.

longDescription.en: UYDEK is a digital transaction infrastructure platform for the real estate market, positioning itself as the operating system for property transactions. Unlike traditional listing platforms, UYDEK orchestrates the complete transaction lifecycle from discovery through completion. The platform features a map-first property discovery experience powered by the Yarrow Map Web SDK, a strictly-sequenced deal flow pipeline (Interest → Verification → Contract → Escrow → Notary → Completed), and a multi-role ecosystem connecting property owners, buyers, individual realtors, agencies, developers, mortgage banks, notaries, and insurance companies. Signature capabilities include digital power of attorney for agencies to fully manage sales on owners' behalf, built-in escrow protection, mortgage application document packages, integrated notary appointment scheduling, and document verification against public records. The frontend is built with Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Base UI (shadcn/ui), Framer Motion, GSAP with ScrollTrigger, Zustand for state management, TanStack Query for server state, React Hook Form with Zod validation, Embla Carousel, and Next Themes with Geist typography. The backend is built with NestJS, TypeScript, Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL, Passport JWT authentication, AWS S3 for media storage, Swagger API documentation, rate limiting via Throttler, Helmet security headers, and Jest for testing.
longDescription.uz: UYDEK — ko'chmas mulk bozori uchun raqamli tranzaksiya infratuzilma platformasi bo'lib, o'zini ko'chmas mulk bitimlarining operatsion tizimi sifatida pozitsiyalaydi. An'anaviy e'lon platformalaridan farqli o'laroq, UYDEK kashf etishdan tortib yakuniga qadar butun tranzaksiya hayotiy davrini boshqaradi. Platforma Yarrow Map Web SDK asosidagi xarita-birinchi mulk kashfiyotini, qat'iy ketma-ket bitim pipelineni (Qiziqish → Tekshiruv → Shartnoma → Eskrou → Notarius → Yakunlangan) va mulk egalari, xaridorlar, realtorlar, agentliklar, quruvchilar, ipoteka banklari, notariuslar va sug'urta kompaniyalarini birlashtiruvchi ko'p rolli ekotizimni taqdim etadi. Asosiy imkoniyatlar: agentliklar uchun raqamli ishonchnoma, o'rnatilgan eskrou himoyasi, ipoteka arizalari hujjat to'plamlari, notarius uchrashuvlarini rejalashtirish va hujjatlarni davlat reestrlari bilan tekshirish. Frontend Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui, Framer Motion, GSAP, Zustand, TanStack Query, React Hook Form va Zod asosida qurilgan. Backend NestJS, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Passport JWT, AWS S3 va Swagger asosida ishlaydi.

description.en: Cirth is a SaaS platform where developers and teams write, version, and publish technical documentation under their own custom domain or a platform subdomain. Features a TipTap rich text editor, multi-version page trees, GitHub import, and custom domain routing at the Edge.
description.uz: Cirth — dasturchilar va jamoalar texnik hujjatlarni o'z maxsus domenida yoki platforma subdomenida yozadigan, versiyalaydigan va nashr qiladigan SaaS platformasi. TipTap boy matn tahriri, ko'p versiyali sahifa daraxtlari, GitHub importi va Edge-da maxsus domen yo'naltirish imkoniyatlarini o'z ichiga oladi.

longDescription.en:
Cirth is a multi-tenant SaaS platform for publishing and managing technical documentation, giving every project its own versioned page tree and a public URL at either a custom domain or a platform subdomain (project.cirth.uz).

The editing experience is built on TipTap — a ProseMirror wrapper with first-class React support — extended with fenced code blocks syntax-highlighted by lowlight/highlight.js, tables, inline links, and a placeholder extension. The GitHub import wizard uses @octokit/rest to list markdown files in any repository, gray-matter to extract frontmatter metadata, and marked/turndown to convert markdown into TipTap-compatible HTML, allowing teams to migrate existing docs without copy-pasting.

Supabase powers the entire backend: PostgreSQL with Row Level Security enforces per-user data ownership without any custom query guards; the Auth module handles email sign-in and OAuth; and @supabase/ssr synchronises session cookies between server components and API route handlers so every Next.js server fetch is authenticated transparently.

Custom domain and subdomain routing lives in proxy.ts rather than Next.js middleware. On every request the proxy resolves the hostname against either the custom_domains or projects Supabase table, caches the result in an Edge-compatible in-memory Map for 60 seconds, and rewrites the URL to the internal /projects/[slug] route — all running in the Next.js Edge Runtime to avoid cold-start latency.

@dnd-kit drives drag-and-drop page reordering in the sidebar and table views with optimistic UI updates. Recharts renders usage analytics in the admin dashboard. next-intl provides full English/Uzbek localisation across both the marketing site and the authenticated workspace. Zustand manages shared project and page selection state across route transitions. Bun is used as the package manager and runtime (next dev/build run via the --bun flag for faster module resolution), and Biome enforces linting and formatting. The project is deployed on Vercel with a daily billing-renewal cron job defined in vercel.json.
longDescription.uz:
Cirth — texnik hujjatlarni nashr qilish va boshqarish uchun ko'p foydalanuvchili SaaS platforma bo'lib, har bir loyihaga maxsus domen yoki platforma subdomenida (project.cirth.uz) o'z versiyalangan sahifa daraxti va umumiy URL beriladi.

Tahrir tajribasi TipTap asosida qurilgan — React-ni birinchi darajada qo'llab-quvvatlovchi ProseMirror o'rami — lowlight/highlight.js orqali sintaksis ajratuvchi kod bloklari, jadvallar, ichki havolalar va placeholder kengaytmasi bilan to'ldirilgan. GitHub import ustasi @octokit/rest yordamida repository-dagi markdown fayllarni ro'yxatlaydi, gray-matter frontmatter metama'lumotlarini ajratib oladi va marked/turndown markdown-ni TipTap-mos HTML-ga aylantiradi — jamoalar mavjud hujjatlarni ko'chirmasdan migratsiya qila oladi.

Supabase butun backendni ta'minlaydi: Row Level Security bilan PostgreSQL maxsus so'rov himoyalarisiz foydalanuvchi egaligini ta'minlaydi; Auth moduli elektron pochta va OAuth kirish imkonini beradi; @supabase/ssr session cookie-larini server komponentlari va API marshrutlari o'rtasida sinxronlashtiradi.

Maxsus domen va subdomen yo'naltirish Next.js middleware o'rniga proxy.ts-da amalga oshiriladi. Har bir so'rovda proxy xost nomini custom_domains yoki projects Supabase jadvali orqali hal qiladi, natijani Edge-mos xotira Map-da 60 soniya keshaydi va URL-ni ichki /projects/[slug] marshruti sifatida qayta yozadi — hammasi kechikishni kamaytirish uchun Next.js Edge Runtime-da.

@dnd-kit sidebar va jadval ko'rinishlarida optimistik UI yangilanishlari bilan sahifalarni qayta tartiblashni ta'minlaydi. Recharts admin dashboard-da foydalanish analitikasini ko'rsatadi. next-intl marketing sayti va ish maydoni bo'ylab inglizcha/o'zbekcha lokalizatsiyani ta'minlaydi. Zustand marshrut o'tishlari bo'ylab umumiy loyiha va sahifa holati boshqaruvini ta'minlaydi. Bun paket menejeri va runtime sifatida ishlatiladi (--bun bayrog'i orqali next dev/build), Biome esa linting va formatlashni ta'minlaydi. Loyiha Vercel-da vercel.json-da belgilangan kunlik billing-renewal cron ishi bilan joylashtirilgan.

description.en: Documentation site builder and hosting platform: write in a rich MDX editor, sync from GitHub, and publish fast static docs to *.cirth.app subdomains or custom domains on Cloudflare. Multi-tenant Bun + Elysia backend with end-to-end type safety.
description.uz: Hujjatlar saytlarini yaratish va hosting platformasi: boy MDX tahrirchisida yozing, GitHub-dan sinxronlang va statik hujjatlarni *.cirth.app subdomenlari yoki maxsus domenda Cloudflare orqali nashr eting. Ko'p foydalanuvchili Bun + Elysia backend, uchidan-uchunga tip xavfsizligi bilan.

longDescription.en:
Cirth v2 is a documentation site builder and hosting platform — create a site, write docs in a rich editor, sync content from GitHub, and publish fast static sites to *.cirth.app subdomains or your own custom domains. The codebase is a Bun monorepo managed by Turborepo: an Elysia API on the Bun runtime, a React 19 + Vite dashboard, an Astro 6 marketing site, and a Cloudflare Worker that routes published sites. End-to-end type safety comes from an Eden Treaty chain — the API exports its Elysia App type, a type-only contracts package re-exports it, and the dashboard's API client is fully typed against it with no code generation.

Writing happens in TipTap (ProseMirror) with custom extensions for callouts (info/warning/danger), tab containers, and code groups. Every save flows through a three-representation pipeline: the editor's JSON is converted to MDX, compiled to HTML with @mdx-js/mdx (remark-gfm, rehype-highlight, rehype-slug), and all three forms are stored per page. Updates automatically snapshot page versions (keeping the last 50), and changing a page's slug creates a redirect from the old path. A site-builder service compiles published pages into a complete static site per version — navigation, theme assets, 404 pages, and redirects included.

Multi-tenancy runs on Better Auth with organizations — every signup auto-provisions a personal workspace — backed by a two-tier SQLite setup: one auth database plus an isolated database per organization holding sites, versions, pages, assets, and redirects. A TenantManager pools connections (LRU eviction, WAL mode, performance pragmas) and auto-migrates tenant schemas on first access, while an Elysia tenant plugin resolves the session and organization per request and hands each route a scoped Drizzle connection.

Content is imported or kept in sync with GitHub: OAuth connect, a repository import flow (markdown and GitBook sources), and webhook-driven sync so pushes deploy automatically. Publishing targets Cloudflare Pages, with a Cloudflare Worker routing *.cirth.app subdomains and custom domains (SSL included) to the latest build; assets live in Cloudflare R2 and routing state in Workers KV.

Billing runs on Lemon Squeezy — subscriptions plus affiliate and referral programs. The dashboard is React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS 4, and shadcn/ui (base-nova style, Tabler icons) with Base UI headless components, React Router, TanStack Query for server state, and React Hook Form with Arktype validation; the API compiles to a native Bun binary. Biome lints and formats the whole monorepo. The project is discontinued, but the source remains available on GitHub.
longDescription.uz:
Cirth v2 — hujjatlar saytlarini yaratish va hosting qilish platformasi: sayt ochasiz, hujjatlarni boy tahrirchida yozasiz, kontentni GitHub-dan sinxronlaysiz va tez statik saytlarni *.cirth.app subdomenlari yoki o'z maxsus domeningizda nashr etasiz. Kod bazasi Turborepo boshqaradigan Bun monoreposidir: Bun runtime-da Elysia API, React 19 + Vite dashboard, Astro 6 marketing sayti va nashr etilgan saytlarni yo'naltiruvchi Cloudflare Worker. Uchidan-uchunga tip xavfsizligi Eden Treaty zanjiri orqali ta'minlanadi — API o'zining Elysia App tipini eksport qiladi, tip-only contracts paketi uni qayta eksport qiladi va dashboard API klienti kod generatsiyasiz to'liq tiplangan bo'ladi.

Yozish TipTap (ProseMirror) da amalga oshadi — callout (info/warning/danger), tab konteynerlari va kod guruhlari uchun maxsus kengaytmalar bilan. Har bir saqlash uch vakillikli pipelinedan o'tadi: tahrirchi JSON'i MDX-ga aylantiriladi, @mdx-js/mdx (remark-gfm, rehype-highlight, rehype-slug) bilan HTML-ga kompilyatsiya qilinadi va uchala shakl ham sahifa bo'yicha saqlanadi. Yangilanishlar sahifa versiyalari snapshotlarini avtomatik yaratadi (oxirgi 50 tasi saqlanadi), sahifa slug-i o'zgarsa eski yo'ldan yangi yo'lga redirect yaratiladi. Site-builder xizmi nashr etilgan sahifalarni har bir versiya uchun to'liq statik saytga kompilyatsiya qiladi — navigatsiya, tema assetlari, 404 sahifalar va redirectlar bilan.

Ko'p foydalanuvchilik Better Auth organizatsiyalari ustida ishlaydi — har bir ro'yxatdan o'tish shaxsiy workspace-ni avtomatik yaratadi — va ikki qatlamli SQLite arxitekturasi bilan qo'llanadi: bitta auth bazasi va har bir organizatsiya uchun alohida baza (saytlar, versiyalar, sahifalar, assetlar, redirectlar). TenantManager ulanishlarni boshqaradi (LRU eviktsiya, WAL rejimi, performansa pragmalari) va tenant sxemalarini birinchi kirishda avtomatik migratsiya qiladi; Elysia tenant plagini har bir so'rovda sessiya va organizatsiyani aniqlab, har bir marshrutga scoped Drizzle ulanishini beradi.

Kontent GitHub orqali import qilinadi yoki sinxron holatda saqlanadi: OAuth ulanish, repository import oqimi (markdown va GitBook manbalari) va webhook asosidagi sinxronlash — push bo'lganda deploy avtomatik ishga tushadi. Nashr Cloudflare Pages-ga qilinadi; Cloudflare Worker *.cirth.app subdomenlari va maxsus domenni (SSL bilan) eng so'nggi build-ga yo'naltiradi; assetlar Cloudflare R2-da, marshrut holati Workers KV-da saqlanadi.

To'lovlar Lemon Squeezy orqali — obunalar, affiliate va referral dasturlari bilan. Dashboard React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS 4 va shadcn/ui (base-nova uslubi, Tabler ikonkalari), Base UI headless komponentlari, React Router, server holati uchun TanStack Query hamda React Hook Form + Arktype validatsiyasi asosida qurilgan; API native Bun binary-siga kompilyatsiya qilinadi. Butun monorepoda Biome lint va formatni ta'minlaydi. Loyiha to'xtatilgan, ammo manba kodi GitHub-da ochiq.

description.en: Third-generation rebuild of the Cirth docs platform: public docs render at runtime from a single org-scoped Postgres — no build-to-deploy pipeline, no per-tenant databases. Bun 1.4 + Elysia API, TanStack Start dashboard, Markdown-canonical content, one-VPS delivery with Docker + Caddy.
description.uz: Cirth hujjatlar platformasining uchinchi avlod qayta qurilishi: ommaviy hujjatlar bitta org-scoped Postgres-dan runtime-da render qilinadi — build-to-deploy pipeline yo'q, per-tenant bazalar yo'q. Bun 1.4 + Elysia API, TanStack Start dashboard, Markdown-kanonik kontent, Docker + Caddy bilan bitta VPS-da yetkazib berish.

longDescription.en:
Cirth v3 is the third generation of the Cirth docs platform, rebuilt around three rules: no per-tenant databases, no build-to-deploy pipeline, and no in-memory cross-request state. Public docs render at runtime from a single org-scoped PostgreSQL through layered caches, so editing in the dashboard makes changes live in seconds — the deploy subsystem that plagued v2 is deleted outright. The whole stack runs on one VPS with Docker Compose and Caddy (on-demand TLS for custom domains), making the "GitBook-class docs at a fraction of the cost" positioning an architectural property rather than a marketing line.

The codebase is a pinned Bun 1.4 monorepo orchestrated by Turborepo, with an Elysia API as the only server — auth, control plane, and public docs rendering — and a TanStack Start (SPA mode) dashboard. TypeBox schemas are the single source of truth for API shapes: packages/contracts derives them from the Drizzle schema via drizzle-typebox, the dashboard's Eden Treaty client types against them, and types flow DB → API → client with zero code generation. Better Auth (email + password, GitHub OAuth, organizations plugin) fronts tenancy.

Tenancy is org → member → role, and the content model is project → section → version → page tree with per-section versioning, so a Changelog section can version independently from Docs. Content is Markdown-canonical — GFM plus a registry of extended directives (:::embed, :::tabs) — importable from MDX (subset), VuePress, GitHub alerts, or GitBook liquid, and exportable as plain Markdown. Authoring uses a CodeMirror 6 editor with live preview, autosave, slash commands, and full-snapshot history with diff/restore; multi-locale content ships with fallback chains and hreflang alternates.

The render path layers caches (in-process LRU → Redis → HTTP ETag/SWR) and purges through Redis generation counters — no cache scans. Postgres FTS powers search behind a SearchService, a Bun-native queue over a Postgres job table (LISTEN/NOTIFY wakeups) runs background work, and billing is Polar.sh behind a PaymentProvider adapter with data-driven plan limits. Asset uploads go through a storage driver with Bun.Image producing WebP variants. Observability — OpenTelemetry traces and structured logs — is in from day one, alongside an RLS-overhead benchmark and a render-path load harness in the test suite.
longDescription.uz:
Cirth v3 — Cirth hujjatlar platformasining uchinchi avlodi bo'lib, uch qoida asosida qayta qurilgan: per-tenant bazalar yo'q, build-to-deploy pipeline yo'q, xotiradagi cross-request holati yo'q. Ommaviy hujjatlar bitta org-scoped PostgreSQL-dan qatlamli keshlar orqali runtime-da render qilinadi — dashboarddagi tahrir bir necha soniyada jonli bo'ladi, v2-ni qiynagan deploy tizimi butunlay o'chirilgan. Butun stack bitta VPS-da Docker Compose va Caddy (maxsus domenlar uchun on-demand TLS) bilan ishlaydi — bu "GitBook-darajadagi hujjatlarni bir necha barobar arzon" pozitsionerasini arxitekturaviy xususiyatga aylantiradi.

Kod bazasi — Turborepo boshqaradigan qat'iy pinlangan Bun 1.4 monorepo: auth, control plane va ommaviy hujjatlarni render qilishni o'zida birlashtirgan yagona server sifatida Elysia API hamda TanStack Start (SPA rejimi) dashboard. TypeBox sxemalari API shakllarining yagona manbaidir: packages/contracts ularni drizzle-typebox orqali Drizzle sxemasidan hosil qiladi, dashboardning Eden Treaty klienti ularga qarab tiplanadi va tiplar DB → API → klient yo'nalishida kod generatsiyasiz oqadi. Tenancy oldida Better Auth (email + parol, GitHub OAuth, organizatsiyalar plagini) turadi.

Tenancy org → member → role shaklida, kontent modeli esa project → section → version → sahifa daraxti bo'lib, har bir section mustaqil versiyalanadi — Masalan, Changelog sectioni Docs-dan alohida versiyalanishi mumkin. Kontent Markdown-kanonik: GFM va kengaytirilgan direktivalar registri (:::embed, :::tabs); MDX (qismiy), VuePress, GitHub alerts yoki GitBook liquid-dan import qilinadi va oddiy Markdown sifatida eksport qilinadi. Mualliflik uchun CodeMirror 6 tahrirchisi ishlatiladi — jonli preview, avtosaqlash, slash buyruqlari va diff/tiklash imkoniyati bilan to'liq snapshot tarixi; ko'p tilli kontent fallback zanjirlari va hreflang muqobil bilan keladi.

Render yo'li keshlarni qatlamlaydi (prosess ichidagi LRU → Redis → HTTP ETag/SWR) va Redis generation counterlari orqali tozalaydi — kesh skanlari yo'q. Qidiruv SearchService ortida Postgres FTS bilan ishlaydi, fon ishlari Postgres job jadvali ustidagi Bun-native navbatda (LISTEN/NOTIFY uyg'otishlari) yuradi, billing esa PaymentProvider adapteri ortida Polar.sh bo'lib, reja limitlari ma'lumotlar asosida boshqariladi. Asset yuklashlar storage drayveri orqali boradi, Bun.Image WebP variantlarini yaratadi. Kuzatuvchanlik — OpenTelemetry trace va strukturaviy loglar — birinchi kundan bor, test to'plamida esa RLS-overhead benchmarki va render yo'li yuk sinovi mavjud.

description.en: Browser-only geophysical tool for cleaning and visualizing ERT/IP survey data from ABEM Terrameter instruments, with multi-pass spike filtering, 2D resistivity pseudosection rendering, and UTM coordinate transformation.
description.uz: ABEM Terrameter asboblaridan olingan ERT/IP tadqiqot ma'lumotlarini tozalash va vizualizatsiya qilish uchun brauzerda ishlovchi geofizik vosita, ko'p bosqichli anomaliya filtri, 2D rezistivlik psevdokesmasi va UTM koordinata transformatsiyasi bilan.

longDescription.en:
ERT/IP Data Cleaner is a browser-only single-page application that processes raw geophysical survey data from ABEM Terrameter instruments (Prosys II/III and Syscal formats) entirely on the client — no server, no data leaves the browser.

The core of the app is a multi-pass filtering pipeline that runs up to eight iterations until convergence. Within each pass: a MAD filter rejects stacks inside the same electrode quadrupole group that deviate too far from the group median resistivity; log-space IQR fences flag spatial outliers across each depth level of the pseudosection; a vertical coherence check demotes isolated points in columns where more than half the depth levels are already gaps; and a local sliding-window MAD filter removes single-point spikes too narrow to be caught by the global IQR. Surviving stacks are averaged with physics-correct Rho recalculation (k × mean(VMN) / mean(IAB)) to preserve instrument-level accuracy, and missing stations are filled by linear interpolation from nearest neighbors at the same depth level.

Cleaned data exports as a Syscal-compatible ISO-8859-1 CSV — byte-level compatible with ProSys III — or as a 4-sheet Excel workbook built with ExcelJS, covering original data with highlighted invalid rows, grouped stacks with averaged rows marked in green, all rejected rows with rejection reasons, and the final cleaned output.

The pseudosection view uses the HTML Canvas API to draw a 2D resistivity section via IDW interpolation on a 320×160 grid with marching-squares contouring, keeping visualization entirely dependency-free with switchable linear and logarithmic color scales. A separate coordinate calculator transforms local electrode positions (measured along the survey profile) into global UTM coordinates using two GPS reference points, correctly handling perpendicular offsets for non-linear profiles, then calls the Open-Meteo REST API to fetch real-world elevations and write them into Global z-columns for 3D-ready output.

React Router DOM v7 manages client-side routing and guards the main cleaner behind a protected route that checks sessionStorage for a session token. Vite powers fast HMR during development, TypeScript enforces type safety end-to-end across parsing, filtering, and export logic, Tailwind CSS v4 and shadcn/ui handle styling, and Biome enforces linting and formatting. Bun is the package manager. The app is deployed on Vercel with an SPA rewrite rule so direct URL navigation works correctly. Because the target users are field geophysicists who expect a native desktop tool, a GitHub Actions matrix workflow triggered on version tags uses Pake — a CLI that wraps any URL into a lightweight desktop app via a Tauri/WebView shell — to cross-compile the live Vercel URL into platform-native installers (Windows MSI, macOS DMG, Linux DEB) without maintaining a separate Tauri project. The built artifacts are automatically uploaded as GitHub Release assets.
longDescription.uz:
ERT/IP Data Cleaner — ABEM Terrameter asboblaridan (Prosys II/III va Syscal formatlari) olingan xom geofizik tadqiqot ma'lumotlarini to'liq mijoz tomonida qayta ishlovchi brauzerda ishlovchi bir sahifali ilova — server yo'q, ma'lumotlar brauzerni tark etmaydi.

Ilovaning asosini natija barqarorlashguncha 8 ta iteratsiyagacha ishlaydigan ko'p bosqichli filtrlash pipeline tashkil etadi. Har bir passda: MAD filtri bir xil elektrod kvadrupol guruhi ichidagi stacklarni guruh median rezistivligidan juda chetga chiqqanlari sababli rad etadi; log-fazoviy IQR chegaralari psevdokesmaning har bir chuqurlik darajasida fazoviy anomaliyalarni aniqlaydi; vertikal izchillik tekshiruvi chuqurlik darajalarining yarmidan ko'pi bo'sh bo'lgan ustunlardagi alohida nuqtalarni o'chiradi; mahalliy sirpanma oyna MAD filtri esa global IQR ushlay olmaydigan tor nuqtali o'rkaklarni olib tashlaydi. Omon qolgan stacklar fizik to'g'ri Rho qayta hisoblash bilan o'rtachalanadi (k × o'rtacha(VMN) / o'rtacha(IAB)) va yo'q stansiyalar bir xil chuqurlik darajasidagi eng yaqin qo'shnilardan chiziqli interpolyatsiya orqali to'ldiriladi.

Tozalangan ma'lumotlar Syscal-mos ISO-8859-1 CSV sifatida — ProSys III bilan bayt darajasida mos — yoki ExcelJS yordamida qurilgan 4 varaqli Excel kitobi sifatida eksport qilinadi: yaroqsiz qatorlar ajratilgan asl ma'lumotlar, yashil rang bilan belgilangan o'rtacha qatorli guruhlangan stacklar, rad etish sabablari ko'rsatilgan barcha yaroqsiz qatorlar va yakuniy tozalangan natija.

Psevdokesma ko'rinishi IDW interpolyatsiya orqali 320×160 katakchali setka bo'ylab 2D rezistivlik kesmani chizish uchun HTML Canvas API'dan foydalanadi, marching-squares konturlash bilan, chiziqli va logarifmik rang shkalalari o'rtasida almashish imkoniyati bilan. Alohida koordinata kalkulyatori mahalliy elektrod pozitsiyalarini (tadqiqot profili bo'ylab o'lchangan) ikkita GPS ta'rif nuqtasi yordamida global UTM koordinatalariga aylantiradi va Open-Meteo REST API'siga murojaat qilib haqiqiy balandliklarni oladi va ularni 3D tayyor chiqish uchun Global z-ustunlariga yozadi.

React Router DOM v7 mijoz tomonidagi marshrutlashni boshqaradi va sessionStorage-dagi sessiya tokenini tekshirib asosiy tozalovchini himoya qiladi. Vite ishlab chiqishda tez HMR ta'minlaydi, TypeScript parsing, filtrlash va eksport mantiqi bo'ylab end-to-end tip xavfsizligini ta'minlaydi, Tailwind CSS v4 va shadcn/ui dizaynni boshqaradi, Biome esa linting va formatlashni ta'minlaydi. Bun paket menejeri sifatida ishlatiladi. Ilova Vercel-da to'g'ridan-to'g'ri URL navigatsiyasi to'g'ri ishlashi uchun SPA qayta yo'naltirish qoidasi bilan joylashtirilgan. Maqsadli foydalanuvchilar native desktop vositasini kutadigan dala geofiziklari bo'lgani uchun, versiya teglari bo'yicha ishga tushadigan GitHub Actions matrix ish jarayoni Pake — har qanday URL ni Tauri/WebView qobig'i orqali yengil desktop ilovaga o'radigan CLI — yordamida alohida Tauri loyihasini qo'llamasdan jonli Vercel URL ni platforma-native o'rnatuvchilarga (Windows MSI, macOS DMG, Linux DEB) cross-kompilyatsiya qiladi. Qurilgan fayllar avtomatik ravishda GitHub Release assetlari sifatida yuklanadi.

description.en: Assembly-line ERP for standardized apartment renovation, engineered as B2B SaaS with schema-per-tenant multi-tenancy on PostgreSQL. A checklist-gated pipeline of ~8 stages drives properties from first inspection through final handover with automated wage credits and real-time notifications.
description.uz: PostgreSQL-da sxema-per-tenant ko'p o'quvchilik bilan B2B SaaS sifatida qurilgan kvartira ta'miri uchun konveyer ERP tizimi. ~8 bosqichli checklist asosidagi pipeline obyektlarni birinchi inspeksiyadan yakuniy topshirishgacha avtomatik ish haqi kreditlari va real vaqt bildirishnomalari bilan yuritadi.

longDescription.en:
ERP Renovation is an assembly-line ERP for standardized apartment renovation, built as a B2B SaaS product from day one with schema-per-tenant multi-tenancy on PostgreSQL. Properties move through a strictly-sequenced, checklist-gated pipeline of ~8 stages: a Master completes each stage and uploads mandatory photos; an Inspector accepts against a digital checklist; acceptance automatically credits the master's wage, unlocks the next stage, and dispatches notifications.

The monorepo is managed by Turborepo over Bun workspaces so each app and shared package builds and caches independently. Elysia — a TypeScript-first Bun framework — powers the API and exposes its types to the React frontend via Eden Treaty, giving end-to-end type safety without code generation. Drizzle ORM enforces hard tenant isolation by routing every query into the correct PostgreSQL schema via a per-request search_path resolver derived from the Better Auth session. Post-acceptance side-effects (wage credit, stage unlock, notifications) run as a BullMQ + Redis job chain separate from the request cycle, making Accept instant and the chain durable through restarts. React Hook Form paired with Zod schemas from a shared validators package keeps the same validation logic on both the browser form and the Elysia route. The frontend is a Vite PWA with TanStack Router for file-based type-safe routing and TanStack Query for server-state caching; an Elysia WebSocket endpoint drives live dashboard updates. Stage and floor-plan photos upload directly from the browser to Cloudflare R2 via Bun.s3 presigned URLs, keeping the app server free of binary traffic. Web Push over VAPID delivers task-available and acceptance notifications to installed PWAs, backed by an in-app inbox that stores every intent regardless of push outcome. @react-pdf/renderer generates the final handover certificate and Plan-vs-Actual financial report at unit closing. GitHub Actions runs the CI pipeline on every push.
longDescription.uz:
ERP Renovation — birinchi kundan B2B SaaS mahsuloti sifatida, PostgreSQL-da sxema-per-tenant ko'p o'quvchilik bilan qurilgan standartlashtirilgan kvartira ta'miri uchun konveyer ERP tizimi. Obyektlar qat'iy ketma-ket, checklist asosidagi ~8 bosqichli pipelindan o'tadi: Usta har bir bosqichni bajarib, majburiy fotolarni yuklaydi; Nazoratchi raqamli checklist asosida qabul qiladi; qabul avtomatik ravishda usta ish haqini yozadi, keyingi bosqichni ochadi va bildirishnomalar yuboradi.

Monoreponi Turborepo Bun workspaces ustida boshqaradi — har bir ilova va umumiy paket mustaqil build qilinadi va keshlanadi. Elysia — TypeScript-birinchi Bun freymvorki — API-ni ta'minlaydi va turlarini Eden Treaty orqali React frontendiga uzatadi, bu kod generatsiyasiz end-to-end tip xavfsizligini beradi. Drizzle ORM Better Auth sessiyasidan olingan per-request search_path resolver orqali har bir so'rovni to'g'ri PostgreSQL sxemasiga yo'naltiradi va qat'iy tenant izolyatsiyasini ta'minlaydi. Qabul oqibatlari (ish haqi krediti, bosqich ochilishi, bildirishnomalar) BullMQ + Redis ish zanjiri sifatida so'rov siklidan alohida ishlaydi. React Hook Form umumiy validators paketidagi Zod sxemalari bilan bir xil validatsiya mantiqini brauzer formasi va Elysia marshrutida ta'minlaydi. Frontend TanStack Router va TanStack Query bilan Vite PWA bo'lib, Elysia WebSocket endpointi jonli dashboard yangilanishlarini ta'minlaydi. Fotolar Bun.s3 oldindan imzolangan URL-lar orqali to'g'ridan-to'g'ri Cloudflare R2 ga yuklanadi. Web Push VAPID orqali o'rnatilgan PWA-larga bildirishnomalar yetkazadi. @react-pdf/renderer yakuniy qabul akti va moliyaviy hisobotni yaratadi. GitHub Actions har bir push-da CI pipelinini ishga tushiradi.

description.en: Documentation site for the Yarrow Map SDK covering Web and Flutter integrations, served in English, Uzbek, and Russian.
description.uz: Yarrow Map SDK uchun Web va Flutter integratsiyalarini qamrab oluvchi hujjatlar sayti, ingliz, o'zbek va rus tillarida taqdim etiladi.

longDescription.en:
Yarrow Map Web SDK Documentation is a single-page application that serves API references, getting-started guides, and code examples for the Yarrow Map SDK across Web and Flutter platforms in three languages (English, Uzbek, Russian).

Vue Router handles client-side navigation between the Web and Flutter SDK sections, keeping transitions instant without full-page reloads. Rather than adopting an off-the-shelf documentation framework, the project ships a hand-built markdown parser (`markdownDocs.ts`) that converts raw `.md` files into typed `DocBlock` structures — covering headings, code fences with language detection, tables, lists, and table-of-contents extraction for sidebar navigation — so content is authored in plain Markdown without a heavy dependency. PrismJS handles syntax highlighting for the embedded code examples. Vue i18n (vue-i18n 9) drives the full three-language experience: sidebar links are re-extracted from the localized markdown on every locale change, and all UI strings update reactively. An IntersectionObserver watches which headings are in the viewport and highlights the corresponding sidebar entry in real time; on mobile the sidebar collapses into an animated hamburger drawer. Dark mode is implemented as a `useDarkMode` composable. Vite builds the project (with `vue-tsc` running a TypeScript check before every production build) and the output is containerized in a multi-stage Docker image built on Node.js Alpine. Both GitHub Actions and GitLab CI pipelines automate building and publishing the image to their respective container registries on every push to `main`.
longDescription.uz:
Yarrow Map Web SDK Documentation — Yarrow Map SDK uchun Web va Flutter platformalarida API ma'lumotnomasi, boshlash qo'llanmalari va kod misollarini uch tilda (ingliz, o'zbek, rus) taqdim etuvchi bir sahifali ilova.

Vue Router Web va Flutter SDK bo'limlari o'rtasida mijoz tomonidagi navigatsiyani boshqaradi — sahifalar to'liq qayta yuklanmasdan tezkor almashadi. Tayyor hujjatlar frameworki o'rniga loyiha xom `.md` fayllarini tipli `DocBlock` strukturalariga aylantiruvchi maxsus markdown parser (`markdownDocs.ts`) bilan jihozlangan — sarlavhalar, til aniqlanishi bilan kod bloklari, jadvallar, ro'yxatlar va sidebar navigatsiyasi uchun mundarija ajratish imkoniyatlari mavjud. PrismJS joylashtirilgan kod misollarini sintaksis bilan ajratib ko'rsatadi. Vue i18n (vue-i18n 9) to'liq uch tilli tajribani ta'minlaydi: sidebar havolalari har bir til o'zgarishida lokallashtirilgan markdowndan qayta ajratib olinadi. IntersectionObserver qaysi sarlavhalar ko'rinish maydonida ekanligini kuzatadi va tegishli sidebar yozuvini real vaqtda ajratib ko'rsatadi; mobil qurilmalarda sidebar animatsiyali tortma menyuga yig'iladi. Qorong'i rejim `useDarkMode` kompozabli orqali amalga oshirilgan. Vite loyihani build qiladi (har bir production build oldidan `vue-tsc` TypeScript tekshiruvini o'tkazadi) va natija Node.js Alpine asosidagi ko'p bosqichli Docker tasviriga joylanadi. GitHub Actions ham, GitLab CI ham `main` ga har bir push'da tasvirni o'z container registrlariga avtomatik build qilib yuklaydi.

longDescription.en: Yarrow Interactive Map Embed is a developer tool built with Nuxt 4 that allows third-party websites to embed Yarrow Maps with a single line of iframe code. longDescription.uz: Yarrow Interactive Map Embed — uchinchi tomon saytlariga Yarrow Xaritalarni bitta qator iframe kodi bilan joylashtirish imkoniyatini beradigan, Nuxt 4 asosida qurilgan dasturchi vositasi. description.en: TypeScript-based mapping library built on top of MapLibre GL. Provides high-level API for interactive maps with routing, search, public transport tracking, and custom layer management.

longDescription.en: Yarrow Map Web SDK is a professional-grade TypeScript mapping library built on top of MapLibre GL. It abstracts low-level mapping complexity into a high-level developer-friendly API. Key features include interactive map rendering, turn-by-turn routing, geocoding search, real-time public transport tracking, and custom layer management for overlaying specialized data. The SDK is packaged and distributed via npm with comprehensive TypeScript declarations. Built with Rollup for bundling, Vitest for unit testing, Axios for HTTP requests, and fully typed with TypeScript. Published as @yarrow-uz/yarrow-map-web-sdk on npm.
longDescription.uz: Yarrow Map Web SDK — MapLibre GL ustiga qurilgan professional darajadagi TypeScript xaritalash kutubxonasi. Past darajadagi xaritalash murakkabligini yuqori darajadagi dasturchi uchun qulay APIga aylantiradi. Asosiy imkoniyatlar: interaktiv xarita render qilish, qadam-baqadam marshrutlash, geokoding qidiruv, real vaqtda jamoat transporti kuzatuvi va maxsus ma'lumotlarni qoplash uchun maxsus qatlam boshqaruvi. SDK to'liq TypeScript deklaratsiyalari bilan npm orqali tarqatiladi. Rollup, Vitest, Axios va TypeScript bilan qurilgan.

description.en: Flutter mobile SDK for integrating Yarrow Maps in mobile applications. Provides API parity with the Yarrow Web SDK for map rendering, routing, search, and public transport tracking.

longDescription.uz: Yarrow Map Flutter SDK — Yarrow Xaritalar funksionalligini Android va iOS ilovalariga olib keladigan native mobil SDK. Yarrow Map Web SDK bilan API parityni saqlab, dasturchilarga web va mobil platformalarda izchil APIlardan foydalanish imkonini beradi. description.en: Client-side code-to-image generator that turns source code into shareable graphics. Pick from 60+ syntax themes, 200+ languages, custom local fonts, and 9 curated background presets — then export as PNG/JPEG.
description.uz: Kodni ulashish mumkin bo'lgan grafikaga aylantiruvchi mijoz tomonidagi vosita. 60+ sintaksis mavzusi, 200+ til, maxsus lokal shriftlar va 9 ta tayyor fon orasidan tanlang va PNG/JPEG sifatida eksport qiling.

longDescription.en:
Code Preview is a browser-only tool that turns code into shareable graphics — no backend, no account, no data leaves the device. The editing surface is a transparent textarea stacked over a syntax-highlighted layer: Shiki's highlighter produces the HTML in the background, and a luma calculation on the theme's background color decides whether the app renders in light or dark mode so the controls always stay legible.

The syntax highlighting engine exposes 60+ themes (Catppuccin family, Dracula variants, GitHub variants, Gruvbox, Tokyo Night, Nord, Solarized, and more) and 200+ languages. The 5 layout presets swap between a bare window, a centered title bar, a macOS traffic-light header, a Windows-style control cluster, and a tab-style variant — each with editable title text.

Backgrounds ship as 9 curated WebP presets (Aurora, Ridge, Coast, Bloom, Dunes, Mist, Circuit, Server, Itachi) plus an upload slot that compresses user images before storing them. Every option (theme, language, font, scale, spacing, blur, opacity, layout, background) is persisted to localStorage via react-use so the editor restores exactly where you left it. The output is rasterized at 4× device pixel ratio through dom-to-image and downloaded as JPEG.

The frontend is built with React 19, TypeScript, Vite (rolldown), Tailwind CSS v4, Base UI (shadcn/ui), lucide-react for icons, class-variance-authority and clsx for styling, with the React Compiler enabled for automatic memoization. Build-time prerendering runs through a Bun script that walks the dist output, inlines critical CSS via html-minifier, and writes static files for a CDN-friendly deploy. Bun is the package manager. Deployed at code.abdukahhar.uz.
longDescription.uz:
Code Preview — kodni ulashish mumkin bo'lgan grafikaga aylantiruvchi brauzerda ishlaydigan vosita — server yo'q, akkaunt yo'q, ma'lumot qurilmani tark etmaydi. Tahrirlash sirti shaffof textarea va sintaksis ajratilgan qatlam ustida joylashgan: Shiki ajratuvchisi fonda HTML yaratadi va mavzu fon rangidagi yorqinlik hisob-kitobi ilova yorug'lik yoki qorong'i rejimda chizilishini aniqlaydi, shunda boshqaruv elementlari doimo o'qilishi mumkin bo'ladi.

Sintaksis ajratish mexanizmi 60+ mavzu (Catppuccin oilasi, Dracula variantlari, GitHub variantlari, Gruvbox, Tokyo Night, Nord, Solarized va boshqalar) va 200+ tilni taqdim etadi. 5 ta layout shabloni odday oynadan markazlangan sarlavha paneli, macOS signal-chiroqlari sarlavhasi, Windows uslubidagi boshqaruv klasteri va tab uslubidagi variantga o'zgartiradi — har biri tahrirlanadigan sarlavha matni bilan.

Fonlar 9 ta tayyor WebP shablon (Aurora, Ridge, Coast, Bloom, Dunes, Mist, Circuit, Server, Itachi) va foydalanuvchi tasvirlarini siqishdan oldin saqlaydigan yuklash teshigi bilan birga keladi. Barcha sozlamalar (mavzu, til, shrift, masshtab, oraliq, loyqalantirish, shaffoflik, layout, fon) react-use orqali localStorage-ga saqlanadi. Chiqish dom-to-image orqali 4× qurilma piksel nisbatida rastrlashtiriladi va JPEG sifatida yuklanadi.

Frontend React 19, TypeScript, Vite (rolldown), Tailwind CSS v4, Base UI (shadcn/ui), lucide-react, class-variance-authority va clsx asosida qurilgan, React Compiler avtomatik memoizatsiya uchun yoqilgan. Build vaqtidagi oldindan renderlash dist natijasini aylanib, html-minifier orqali muhim CSS ni ichki kiritadi va CDN-ga qulay deploy uchun statik fayllarni yozadi. Bun paket menejeri sifatida ishlatiladi. code.abdukahhar.uz da joylashtirilgan.

description.en: Personal AI tool that tailors a resume to a job post and renders an exactly-one-page PDF with zero dead space. An OpenCode agent skill writes and audits the content; a zero-dependency Bun script binary-searches the root font size in headless Chromium, prints to PDF, and verifies the fit.
description.uz: Rezyumeni ish e'loniga moslashtiradigan va aynan bir sahifali, bo'sh joy qoldirmaydigan PDF yaratadigan shaxsiy AI vositasi. OpenCode agent skill-i kontentni yozadi va tekshiradi; dependensiyasiz Bun skripti headless Chromium-da ildiz shrift o'lchamini binar qidiruv bilan moslaydi, PDF chop etadi va natijani tekshiradi.

longDescription.en:
Resume Tailor is a personal AI tool that tailors a resume to a specific job post and renders it as an exactly-one-page PDF with zero dead space. It is built for OpenCode — any agent-skills-compatible assistant works — but is fully usable standalone. The division of labor is the whole point: the AI never touches layout, and the renderer never rewrites content. The resume-tailor skill picks which projects to feature, rewrites bullets against the job post, and reorders skill emphasis; a read-only auditor subagent independently fact-checks the draft against the profile, portfolio, and job post before anything renders.

Layout fitting is mechanical. scripts/render.mjs — a zero-dependency Bun script — composes content.json into a locked Letter-size HTML/CSS template with exactly one knob: the root font size. It loads the composed page in headless Chromium, measures real rendered content height against the printable area, and binary-searches the largest font size (8–14px by default) whose content fits, then prints to PDF and verifies the result: exactly one page, fill ≥ 92% of the printable height, no vertical gap between blocks larger than three line-heights, and no empty elements.

Every run prints a JSON verdict — PASS, TOO_MUCH (overflows even at the minimum font: trim), MULTI_PAGE, DEAD_SPACE (under-filled: add content), or INVALID_CONTENT (schema violation) — with exit code 0 only on PASS, so failures are actionable by both humans and agents. Personal data (profile.md, config.local.json, output/) is gitignored, so the repo can be published without exposing anything private; forking it and swapping in your own profile and template is the intended reuse. The only way the model influences the fit is by writing less or more content.
longDescription.uz:
Resume Tailor — rezyumeni aniq bir ish e'loniga moslashtiradigan va uni aynan bir sahifali, bo'sh joy qoldirmaydigan PDFga aylantiradigan shaxsiy AI vositasi. U OpenCode uchun qurilgan (agent-skills-mos har qanday yordamchi ishlaydi), lekin mustaqil ham to'liq ishlaydi. Ishlarni taqsimlash asosiy g'oyadir: AI hech qachon maketga tegmaydi, renderer esa kontentni qayta yozmaydi. resume-tailor skill-i qaysi loyihalarni ko'rsatishni tanlaydi, bullet-larni ish e'loniga qarab qayta yozadi va skill ustuvorligini o'zgartiradi; read-only auditor subagenti esa hech narsa render qilinishidan oldin loyiha profil, portfolio va ish e'loni asosida mustaqil tekshiradi.

Maketga moslashtirish mexanik jarayon. scripts/render.mjs — dependensiyasiz Bun skripti — content.json-ni bitta sozlanadigan parametri bor qulflangan Letter o'lchamidagi HTML/CSS shablonga joylaydi: ildiz shrift o'lchami. U tuzilgan sahifani headless Chromium-da yuklaydi, haqiqiy render balandligini chop etish maydoni bilan o'lchaydi va kontentga sig'adigan eng katta shrift o'lchamini (standart 8–14px) binar qidiruv bilan topadi, so'ng PDF chop etadi va natijani tekshiradi: aynan bir sahifa, chop etish maydonining ≥ 92%i to'ldirilgan, bloklar orasidagi vertikal bo'shliq uch qator balandligidan katta bo'lmasligi va bo'sh elementlar yo'qligi.

Har bir ishga tushirish JSON verdict chiqaradi — PASS, TOO_MUCH (minimum shriftda ham sig'maydi: qisqartirish kerak), MULTI_PAGE, DEAD_SPACE (kam to'ldirilgan: kontent qo'shish kerak) yoki INVALID_CONTENT (sxema buzilishi) — va faqat PASS holatda exit code 0 beradi, shuning uchun xatolar ham odamlar, ham agentlar uchun tushunarli. Shaxsiy ma'lumotlar (profile.md, config.local.json, output/) gitignored — repoga hech narsa maxfiy qoldirmasdan ochiq joylashtirish mumkin; uni fork qilib o'z profilingiz va shabloningizni ulash nazarda tutilgan qayta foydalanish usulidir. Modelning maketga yagona ta'siri — kamroq yoki ko'proq kontent yozishidir.
